## Architecture Overview

The `BucketStore` struct is defined in `thanos/pkg/store/bucket.go` (line 396). It is the primary object-storage-backed store for reading historical time-series blocks. Mimir has its own `BucketStore` implementation in `pkg/storegateway/bucket.go` (line 85) with a multi-tenant wrapper `BucketStores` in `bucket_stores.go`. Loki does NOT use BucketStore.

## Detailed Analysis

### Thanos

- **`pkg/store/bucket.go`** (line 396) — Primary `BucketStore` struct definition with `blockLifecycleCallback` field. Has `SyncBlocks()` method (line 736). Must add `SyncWithCallback()`.
- **`pkg/store/bucket_test.go`** — Comprehensive unit tests with mocks: `fakePool`, `mockedPool`, `bytesLimiterMock`, `mockBlockLifecycleCallback` (line 4270).
- **`pkg/store/bucket_e2e_test.go`** — E2E tests for BucketStore.
- **`pkg/store/lazy_postings_test.go`** — Tests lazy posting functionality.
- **`pkg/store/acceptance_test.go`** — Acceptance tests.
- **`cmd/thanos/store.go`** — Instantiates and configures BucketStore for the thanos store command.

### Mimir

- **`pkg/storegateway/bucket.go`** (line 85) — Mimir's own `BucketStore` struct. Different from thanos, multi-tenant aware.
- **`pkg/storegateway/bucket_stores.go`** (line 54) — `BucketStores` multi-tenant wrapper managing map of `*BucketStore` per tenant (line 83). Must delegate `SyncWithCallback()` to all tenants.
- **`pkg/storegateway/gateway.go`** — Main gateway orchestrating BucketStore instances.
- **`pkg/storegateway/bucket_test.go`** — Unit tests with many test doubles.
- **`pkg/storegateway/bucket_e2e_test.go`** — E2E tests with `testBucketStoreCase`.
- **`pkg/storegateway/bucket_stores_test.go`** — Tests for multi-tenant wrapper.
- **`pkg/storegateway/bucket_store_metrics.go`** — Metrics for BucketStore operations.
- **`pkg/querier/blocks_store_queryable.go`** — Querier using BucketStore for historical queries (12 references).
- **`pkg/storage/tsdb/config.go`** — `BucketStoreConfig` struct (line 423).
